Mandatory languages: Arabic and English


We're on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will grow into the high-impact, visionary person you know you're ready to be, taking on new challenges and developing new skills every day in our AI-first cloud environment.

Would you like to be part of a team that helps customers across EMEA adopt AWS cloud solutions and accelerate their digital transformation.

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, AWS is developing the next generation of commercial leaders. Our Commercial Sales Internship Program offers a structured roadmap of in-depth learning and hands-on practice across AWS services and solution selling, preparing you for a future Sales role while you deliver long-term impact through a real business project.

AWS offers a dynamic and motivating environment where you will advance your career, support the growth of AWS customers, and help shape the future of emerging cloud and AI technologies. As you build customer-readiness, the role becomes partly external-facing, giving you real exposure to customers.

This paid internship gives you the chance to take on a real business project, developed in a team connected to Amazon Global Sales. You'll work with a range of stakeholders across AWS, making a tangible impact and building and innovating in the Amazonian way. Throughout, you'll be supported by our EMEA internship community, working in agile teams with access to mentoring, learning, and shadowing opportunities.

Key job responsibilities
What Makes You Future-Ready:
• Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach
• Digital innovation mindset with genuine curiosity about AI and emerging cloud technologies
• Showcasing resilience and adaptability in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
• Customer and stakeholder focus with strong communication skills
• Cross-functional collaboration capabilities to work across different teams and business units

The program includes comprehensive training on AWS services, cloud computing concepts, AI-first methodologies, and hands-on practical exercises to solidify your learning. You'll develop strategic thinking capabilities, GenAI proficiency, and stakeholder management skills essential for success in our rapidly evolving AI environment.
The successful candidate will be interested in a career in cloud technology, demonstrating learning agility, comfort with digital tools, and the ability to think strategically while remaining adaptable to new challenges and technologies that drive and grow AWS footprint with our customers.

A day in the life
Learn about the AWS solution portfolio (including earning certifications like the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AWS Certified AI Practitioner) and the Amazon culture, with strong focus on AI services and innovative cloud solutions
• Rotation assignments across different business units and teams, collaborating with various team members to innovate
• Work within agile methodologies to deliver impactful business projects
• Build an understanding of customer challenges, requirements, and the potential value that can be delivered by AWS
• Differentiate and understand various IT roles and responsibilities in modern AI-first organizations


If you're insatiably curious and eager to learn, then you've come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, the following benefits may be available to you as an intern:
• Competitive pay
• Impactful project and internship deliverables with rotation opportunities
• Agile team collaboration and innovative project work
• Networking opportunities with fellow interns across different EMEA locations
• Internship events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions, and AI technology workshops
• Mentorship and career development

About the team
Successful applicants will be invited to an online assessment. If successful and selected by the hiring team, you'll be invited for a first virtual interview. If you progress through this stage, you'll then be invited for a final round of interviews consisting of a combination of interviews and case studies, focusing on our Leadership Principles and your ability to work in Agile, innovative environments. Please note that this selection process is subject to change and may vary depending on the role and location.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

jobs.description:
When you join Amazon as an Area/Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.

Key job responsibilities
- Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
- Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
- Analyse performance and suggest process improvements to optimise work and improve customer service
- Collaborate with other managers to standardise shift processes

A day in the life
You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritising routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.

Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analysing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

jobs.description:
Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us!

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

- Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region

- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures

- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support

- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered

- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday to Thursday.

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.
